## The plan of the test

1. **build_phase** — recording_detail = 1 for every component; configure_sequences() hook (empty here); router_tb created
2. **topology** — print_topology() at end_of_elaboration
3. **run_phase** — no stimulus of its own; drain time 200 ns after the last objection drops
4. **check_phase** — check_config_usage(): every setting nobody read

Expected:

- The topology report lists uvm_test_top : base_test with the whole router_tb below it.
- No sequence runs, so the DUT sees no clock and no packet; the run ends after the drain time with UVM_ERROR : 0.
- Every other test extends it and only changes what runs (configure_sequences, build_phase, run_phase).
